items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: they had this guy, Rubenstein, Marty Rubenstein, kind of interviewing me and talking to me

ctx.x: And it was about a year later, they found enough money to pay me what the union scale was to do it. So I came back and did it again. And then they got interested in me
doing it with a band. And they had this guy, Rubenstein, Marty Rubenstein, kind of interviewing me and talking to me, the new and the old.
Yeah, he's a very fine pianist, too.
